name: IS DongSeo Co., Ltd.
summary: IS DongSeo Co., Ltd. engages in the construction and construction materials businesses in South Korea. It is involved in construction business, that includes housing, business, civil, and urban development; environment, that includes waste recycling, lithium-ion battery recycling, auto resource recycling, EPC-O&M environmental facilities, and new renewable energy business; and concrete business, that includes PICE and PC products.
